span.p:
TTL Scheduler Thread
Sleep until next expiration
→ Wake up → Check min-heap
→ Evict expired entries
→ Sleep until next expiration

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Insert: O(log n) — push onto heap, sift up
Peek: O(1) — read root
Evict: O(log n) — pop root, sift down

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Redis uses a different approach:
Each key stores expiration time in the hash table entry.
Every 100ms, Redis samples 20 random keys and evicts expired ones.
This avoids maintaining a separate heap.
